declarations.docstring: A type indexed by a natural number, a finitely supported exponent function, and a permutation.
A type indexed by two natural-valued functions on a finite index type.
A finitely supported exponent on the displayed two-sided index type associated to two weight functions.
The paired exponent has the first weight as its coefficient on a left index.
The paired exponent has the second weight as its coefficient on a right index.
Under injectivity and pointwise equality of the weights, the coefficient at the displayed auxiliary exponent is one.
Expresses the indicated coefficient as a signed sum over permutations satisfying a pointwise equality condition.
The coefficient of the displayed auxiliary polynomial is the cardinality of the corresponding permutation fiber.
The indicated coefficient of the inverse of one minus a product of variables is an equality indicator.
Identifies the displayed auxiliary definition with the paired exponent formed from a weight function twice.
Relates a sum of products of permutation-fiber cardinalities to a factorial times a weight-pair-fiber cardinality.
A multivariate power series over a commutative ring on the displayed index type.
When every first weight is bounded by the index size, this coefficient equals the cardinality of the weight-pair fiber.
Provides a finite-type structure for each permutation fiber.
Provides a finite-type structure for each weight-pair fiber.
Relates a sum of products of auxiliary-polynomial coefficients to a factorial times an indicated paired-exponent coefficient.
For an injective weight function, the displayed double signed permutation sum is one.
For strictly antitone weight functions, the displayed double signed permutation sum equals their equality indicator.
